messages.author: Hiren
messages.text:
This is our release process from now on:
1. Create a release branch from main
2. Merge development into it
3. Run changeset version to update the changelog and the version
4. Push and open a PR to main
5. Merging the PR publishes to npm

messages.author: Dana
messages.text: After a long discussion with the team about incidents we have settled how we do it going forward. The person who notices the problem opens a channel and posts what they see. The on-call engineer takes over and is the only one who changes production. Someone else writes a timeline as it happens so that nobody has to remember it later. When it is fixed we wait a day and then write a short review together, without blame, and we keep the review in the nest.
